notes: 'no man knoweth' is read with לֹא taking the determiner 'no', the clause's negation having been recast onto the subject nominal (rule 15); the competing reading would keep 'not' on the negative and treat 'no' as added, but the ASV writes only the one word. Rule 35's fusion does not reach it, since the ASV spends a word on each morpheme.
'knoweth of': the 'of' is the object marker's, the preposition through which the English verb reaches its object (rule 16).
'unto this day' gives the written 'this' to the demonstrative pronoun, leaving the noun's article and the agreement article both unrepresented (rules 41, 47).
